title: Work bound for the learning program
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, and let $M$ be a positive integer. Every output and cost pair in the support of the program’s run on $f$ has local work at most $2^{42}(n+1)^3(M+1)^8/\varepsilon^{10}$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the $n$-dimensional cube
The output and cost pair is in the run’s support
